label: GO after an unrewarded trial, choosing a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (all activation mass; never at D1, one D2 step). Within GO it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward=0 carries 96% of mass, rewarded 4%) and the agent to be choosing a2 (model_act=2 carries 94% of mass; choice logit strongly negative). It is also strongly tied to the start of the episode: rate 33x at ep_trial 0, ~57% of mass in trials 0-9, falling off to nothing after trial ~40, so it looks like an early-episode / not-yet-settled signal. Top windows show activation building over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 choices and stopping once a reward arrives, but requiring two unrewarded trials in a row lowered F1, so that claim is only qualitative. Within the predicate, magnitude is larger with higher value (value > 7.54) and more negative choice logits. It does not fire after rewarded trials, at D1/D2, or on a1 choices (6% of mass). The predicate uses only observed inputs, the agent own GO choice and the episode trial index (no future variables). Dev F1 0.64, mass recall 0.87. Precision is ~0.54 because many early unrewarded a2 GO steps are silent, so the description is incomplete.
